questions.question: ‘You should keep your promise.’ বাক্যটির Passive form হবে
options: Your promise should be kept by you.
Your promise is to be kept by you.
Your promise should keep by you.
Your promise should kept by you.
questions.explanation: Modal Auxiliary 'should' যুক্ত বাক্যের Passive গঠন: Object (Your promise) + should be + V3 (kept) + by you। তাই ক সঠিক।
questions.correct_answer: Your promise should be kept by you.

questions.question: Am I wanted by you? বাক্যটির Active form হবে-
questions.explanation: Passive Interrogative 'Am I wanted by you?'-এর Active রূপ হলো Present Indefinite: 'Do you want me?'

questions.question: Anwar said, “I have done the 20 sum.” বাক্যটির Indirect Speech হবে-
options: Anwar said that I have done the sum.
Anwar said that I had done the sum.
Anwar said that he had done the sum.
Anwar said that he has done the sum.
questions.explanation: Direct speech-এর Present Perfect (have done) Indirect speech-এ Past Perfect (had done)-এ রূপান্তরিত হয়: 'Anwar said that he had done the sum.'
questions.correct_answer: Anwar said that he had done the sum.

questions.question: He asked me where I had gone the previous day. বাক্যটির Direct Speech হবে-
options: He said to me, “Where did you go yesterday?
He asked me,” Where have you gone yesterday?”
He asked me, “Where had you gone previous day?”
He said to me, “Where did you go Previous day?”
questions.explanation: Indirect speech-এর 'where I had gone the previous day' Direct speech-এ Past Indefinite 'Where did you go yesterday?' হবে। তাই ক সঠিক।
questions.correct_answer: He said to me, “Where did you go yesterday?
